title: Saul Persecutes the Church
description: After Stephen's martyrdom, a great persecution breaks out against the church in Jerusalem. Saul ravages the church by dragging men and women from their homes and throwing them into prison. The believers are scattered throughout Judea and Samaria, while the apostles remain in Jerusalem, and those who were scattered preach the Word wherever they go.

versions.title: Saul Persecutes the Church
